title: Apple macOS Hydra ABC File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Apple macOS. Interaction with the Hydra framework is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The specific flaw exists within the Hydra framework. Crafted data in an ABC image can trigger a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
